يقترفوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِفُوا (yaqtarifū) /jaq.ta.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# يُقْتَرَفُوا (yuqtarafū) /juq.ta.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
